verdict_text: YES. The script derives `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2` and `transpose` from `adapter_config.json`, computes `delta = B @ A` as `[6144, 2048]` with no transposition since `fan_in_fan_out` is false, accumulates in float32 (`sd[key].float() + scale * delta`, with the adapter already float32) and casts back to the original float16 dtype — note the right-hand side is fully evaluated before rebinding, so `sd[key].dtype` is the pre-merge float16. It touches only the 16 adapted keys in place, so no adapter or intermediate tensor ever enters `sd` and the other 228 tensors stay bit-exact. All four required checks are asserted before writing: 16 merges, no `lora_` name, the layer-0 QKV shape `[6144, 2048]`, and 244 tensors; missing adapter keys would raise `KeyError` rather than silently reduce the count. Sharding at 536,870,912 bytes is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors`, which is outside the shown artifact and so is not assessed here.
